rejected.title: Revolutionary ideas
card: Liberalism
Liberals wanted a constitution, an elected parliament and legal rights such as free speech. They wanted to limit the tsar's power, not end the monarchy.
Marxism

Marxists followed Karl Marx. They said history is a struggle between classes, and that industrial workers (the proletariat) would overthrow the owners of factories and land and build a society without private ownership of them.
Lenin's party
Lenin argued that workers alone would only fight for better wages. He said a small, disciplined party of dedicated revolutionaries must lead them.
All three ideas challenged the tsar's rule, but they asked for different things: limits on the tsar, rule by workers, or rule led by a party.
rejected.remember: Liberals wanted limits on the tsar. Marxists wanted workers to rule. Lenin wanted a party to lead them.

a.q: Which belief was part of Russian liberalism?
opts: The tsar's power should be limited by an elected parliament
The proletariat should overthrow factory and land owners
A disciplined party of revolutionaries should lead workers
Workers should win only better wages from factory owners
a.why: Liberals wanted a constitution and an elected parliament to limit the tsar. Overthrowing owners is a Marxist idea, and leadership by a disciplined party is Lenin's idea, so neither describes liberalism.
a.clue: Liberals wanted to limit the tsar, not to end the monarchy.

b.q: Anna, a factory worker in Petrograd in 1903, says: 'Left to ourselves, we workers will only strike for higher pay. Dedicated revolutionaries must direct us.' Whose idea does she repeat?
opts: Lenin's idea that a party must lead the workers
The liberal idea that a parliament should limit the tsar
Marx's idea that a class struggle drives history
The tsar's idea that all power must stay with him
b.why: Anna repeats Lenin's argument that workers alone only fight for better wages, so committed revolutionaries must lead them. Marx's idea is tempting because Lenin was a Marxist, but Marx's view of class struggle does not say workers need a small group to direct them.
b.clue: Which thinker doubted workers would go beyond pay demands unaided?
